subject: Screen debut

description: The teen gang picture that made Poe a star and led to a run of sequels.
subject: Lo' Waist Gang series

description: The film that won Poe his first FAMAS Award for Best Actor.
subject: FAMAS Best Actor

title: Asedillo
creator: Celso Ad. Castillo
description: Poe plays Teodoro Asedillo, a schoolteacher turned rebel during the American colonial period. It brought him his second FAMAS Award for Best Actor.
subject: FAMAS Best Actor; Biographical

description: Poe plays an underdog fighter who wins against the odds. His third FAMAS Award for Best Actor, in the most awarded film of the 28th FAMAS Awards.
subject: FAMAS Best Actor

creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe is Flavio, a blacksmith who forges a sword from a fallen meteorite to fight the tyrant Lizardo. Based on the komiks by Carlo J. Caparas, it was the first of four Panday films.
subject: Panday series; Based on komiks; Directed by FPJ

description: Poe's fourth FAMAS Award for Best Actor, shared in a tie with Eddie Garcia.
subject: FAMAS Best Actor

title: Ang Padrino
creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)

subject: FAMAS Best Director; Directed by FPJ

description: Poe's fifth FAMAS Award for Best Actor, the win that led to his place in the FAMAS Hall of Fame in 1988.
subject: FAMAS Best Actor

creator: Ronwaldo Reyes (Fernando Poe Jr.)
description: Poe's second FAMAS Award for Best Director.

description: A provincial policeman takes the place of his slain twin brother in Manila. The film was later remade as the long-running television series FPJ's Ang Probinsyano.
